c1-control.reason: infrastructure: AgentV SDK unavailable (missing node_modules/@agentv/core in this checkout); scripts.evaluate_model raised RuntimeError before any scoreboard was produced

c1-bounds.reason: infrastructure: same AgentV SDK unavailable failure as c1-control (identical class, not a model/quality outcome)

conclusion: Both arms hard-failed at eval-publish time with 'AgentV SDK is unavailable; run npm ci in the checkout or set AGENTV_RUNNER' — this sandbox checkout never ran `npm ci`, so `node_modules/@agentv/core` was missing. No model/quality signal was produced. Self-healed in-session by running `npm ci` (with the sandbox's ambient NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" unset for the child `node` invocation, which otherwise fails independently: `node: --import tsx is not allowed in NODE_OPTIONS`) and replayed as cycle 2, which completed and published real scoreboards — confirming the blocker was environment setup, not a harness defect.
next_priorities: No code/harness change is warranted: this was a fresh-checkout setup gap (missing `npm ci`), not a reproducible harness defect — do not open a harness lane for it.
Continuous-driver operators in fresh sandboxes should run `npm ci` (Node deps for scripts.evaluate_model's AgentV publish step) before the first cycle.
Re-run bounds vs control once npm deps are present (done next as cycle 2, with the driver's own thrash rotation selecting a different arm).
